title: PIES 8.0 Parts Catalog — shape schema
description: Auto Care PIES 8.0 conformant structural shape for the parts_catalog Iceberg product. Encodes element names and structural relationships ONLY. Does NOT encode licensed Auto Care Brand Table BrandAAIAID value ranges, PCdb PartTerminologyID ranges, or PAdb AttributeID ranges — those are subscription-based licensed property (Auto Care Technology License Agreement, rev. 2025-02-28). Every synthetic identifier in seed data lives in a DMS-prefixed namespace (DMS-BR-*, DMS-PT-*, DMS-PA-*). Source: Auto Care Association PIES 8.0 standard (released 2026-04-02); shape derived from publicly available documentation. Verified: 2026-08-27.

brand_aaia_id.description: Brand identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-BR-* synthetic value; never a real Auto Care Brand Table BrandAAIAID (licensed). Pattern enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py (value-space) and by this schema (shape).

part_terminology_id.description: Part terminology identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-PT-* synthetic value; never a real Auto Care PCdb PartTerminologyID (licensed). Shape enforced by this schema; value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

part_terminology_name.description: Human-readable part type name (e.g., 'Brake Pad Set', 'Oil Filter'). May reference PCdb terminology names where publicly known from documentation.

description.description: Long description of the part (PIES 8.0 DescriptionCode='DES').

quantity_per_application.description: Quantity required per vehicle application (PIES 8.0 Quantity element).

upc.description: Universal Product Code (PIES 8.0 ItemLevelGTIN13/UPC element). Null if not assigned.

hazardous_material_code.description: Hazardous material identifier (PIES 8.0 HazardousMaterialCode element). Null if non-hazardous.

country_of_origin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for country of origin (PIES 8.0 CountryOfOrigin element).

package_unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure for packaging (PIES 8.0 PackageUOM element, e.g., 'EA', 'PR', 'KT').

package_quantity.description: Number of items per package (PIES 8.0 QuantityOfEaches element).

package_weight.description: Package weight in kilograms (PIES 8.0 Weight element). Null if not specified.

package_height.description: Package height in centimetres (PIES 8.0 Height element). Null if not specified.

package_width.description: Package width in centimetres (PIES 8.0 Width element). Null if not specified.

package_length.description: Package length in centimetres (PIES 8.0 Length element). Null if not specified.

superseded_part_number.description: If this part supersedes another, the previous part number (PIES 8.0 SupersededPartNumber element). Null if no supersession on the catalog row; full supersession chain lives in parts_interchange.

extended_attributes.description: PIES 8.0 ExtendedInformation / Attribute elements. Array of attribute objects.

attribute_id.description: Attribute identifier — opaque varchar. In this repo always a DMS-PA-* synthetic value; never a real Auto Care PAdb AttributeID (licensed). Shape enforced by this schema; value-space enforced by lint_no_licensed_autocare_ids.py.

attribute_value.description: Value for this attribute (PIES 8.0 Attribute value text).

uom.description: Unit of measure for the attribute value, if applicable.

digital_assets.description: PIES 8.0 DigitalAssets / Asset elements (product images, diagrams, documents).

asset_type.description: PIES 8.0 AssetType code (e.g., 'P04' for Product Image, 'P05' for Exploded View).

access_channel.description: REPAIR Act forward-readiness dimension (ADP spec Decision 3, 2026-08-27). v1 seeds and enables 'franchise' only. The 'independent' value is a schema placeholder for aftermarket data-access surfaces; no independent-aftermarket persona, API, or seed corpus exists in v1. Presence of this column avoids a schema rewrite when/if REPAIR Act (H.R. 1566 / S. 1379) advances.

tenant_id.description: Catalog partition column per DMS T1.5 invariant. DMS seeds 'dms-reference'; CVX Zone 2 rows use 'cvx-zone2'. Queries MUST scope on tenant_id. Null only on rows seeded before the partition invariant was introduced (backfill pending).
